title: SensorThings to GeoPackage
description: Exports Observations from an OGC SensorThings API v1.1 service to a GeoPackage (stdout). IPT: stderr OGC_PROCESSING_PROGRESS + OGC_PROCESSING_META, then describeProcessing STAC.

url.title: Observations URL
url.description: STA Observations collection URL (or nested Observations URL). Required.

filter.title: OData $filter
filter.description: Optional OData filter applied to Observations (e.g. phenomenonTime ge 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z).

top.title: Page size
top.description: OData $top page size when paging Observations.

max_observations.title: Maximum observations
max_observations.description: Fetch exactly this many observations when the server has enough (0 = no limit). Uses paged HTTP requests; prefer top=1000 for large values.
